content.value_statement: Trading simulations need a repeatable process for market analysis, setup selection, and risk controls. This skill provides an ICT and Smart Money Concepts workflow for documented BTC/USDT backtest decisions in Alpha Harness.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes BTC/USDT with a 4H market bias and 15-minute entry framework.
Defines trade, watch, note, and no-action decisions using stated confluence criteria.
Documents liquidity sweeps, change of character, fair value gaps, and order blocks.
Builds simulated orders with entry, stop, target, expiry, and recorded reasoning.
Applies a 2% maximum risk rule and a one-order concurrency limit.
Sets price alarms for liquidity, fair value gap, order block, and structure levels.
limitations: It is designed for Alpha Harness simulations and does not connect to a live exchange.
It covers only BTC/USDT using 4H and 15-minute timeframes.
It provides a methodology, not guaranteed profitable trading outcomes.
It depends on the harness to supply closed-candle data and enforce order constraints.

use_cases.title: Practice a repeatable backtest process
use_cases.description: Review simulated BTC/USDT candles, identify confluence, and record a clear trade or watch decision.

use_cases.title: Audit simulated trade decisions
use_cases.description: Capture bias, liquidity, entry, stop, target, and risk reasoning for later review.

use_cases.title: Run disciplined harness sessions
use_cases.description: Use the wake protocol to check state, analyze structure, manage one order, and set alarms.

prompt_templates.title: Start a market review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SMC Harness workflow to review the current BTC/USDT simulation. State the 4H bias, 15-minute structure, key liquidity levels, and whether to trade, watch, note, or wait.

prompt_templates.title: Create a watch setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT for a possible liquidity sweep and fair value gap setup. If confirmation is incomplete, create a WATCH setup with clear invalidation conditions and price alarms.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a trade candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this BTC/USDT candidate using the 4H and 15-minute SMC framework. Require a sweep, change of character, entry zone, stop, target, and at least 2:1 reward-to-risk before recommending a simulated order.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an active order
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the active Alpha Harness order against its original thesis. Check current structure, invalidation, liquidity targets, and risk rules. Recommend keeping, cancelling, or documenting the outcome without opening a second order.

output_examples.input: Review the current BTC/USDT simulation for a possible long.
output: 4H bias: bullish while higher highs and higher lows remain intact.
15-minute status: wait for a sell-side liquidity sweep and bullish change of character.
Decision: WATCH. Set an alarm at the identified swing low and record the required confirmation.

output_examples.input: Assess a proposed short with entry 96,800, stop 97,200, and target 93,800.
output: Reward-to-risk is 7.5:1 based on the stated levels.
The setup is valid only if the 4H bias is bearish, buy-side liquidity was swept, and the 15-minute change of character is confirmed.
Decision: create a documented simulated setup before placing an order.

best_practices: Use only closed candles and record the evidence for every setup.
Wait for higher-timeframe alignment, a liquidity sweep, and lower-timeframe confirmation.
Use a stop beyond invalidation and require at least 2:1 reward-to-risk.
anti_patterns: Do not place a simulated order before creating and documenting its setup.
Do not trade against an unclear higher-timeframe bias or without a confirmed sweep.
Do not open a second order while an active order exists.

faq.question: Does this skill place live exchange orders?
faq.answer: No. It is written for Alpha Harness backtesting simulations.

faq.question: Which timeframes does it use?
faq.answer: It uses 4H for bias and 15 minutes for entries.

faq.question: What confirms an entry?
faq.answer: The workflow requires a relevant liquidity sweep, a change of character, and a fair value gap or order block.

faq.question: How does it manage risk?
faq.answer: The harness limits risk to 2% per trade and allows one concurrent order.

faq.question: Can it guarantee profitable results?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured simulation methodology and cannot guarantee outcomes.
